description: Daily mean streamflow (default) or stage for a USGS gauge over the last 2 to 366 days, with first, last, low, high, mean and change. Use it for trend, drought and "is the river rising" questions. Many gauges publish daily means for discharge only.

days.description: Days back from today, 2 to 366. Default 30.

parameter.description: discharge (streamflow, ft3/s), gage_height (stage, ft) or water_temperature (deg C). Default discharge.

site.description: USGS site number (for example "07010000" for the Mississippi River at St. Louis) or an NWS gauge id (for example "EADM7"). Use find_river_gauges to look one up.

name: get_river_history
title: Get river level history
